summary_md: **vibeconf ([@vibeconf](https://x.com/vibeconf/status/2115845835464536513))** shows **vibeconf**, an open-source app that makes AI agents real participants in video calls, here two Claude Code sessions, a Codex session and a Grok bot taking turns in a Google Meet ([wanderingstan/vibeconf-app](https://github.com/wanderingstan/vibeconf-app)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - wanderingstan/vibeconf-app: AI agents as real participants in your video calls — the open-source desktop client (Electron + MCP). Bots join Google Meet, Zoom, Slack, Teams, Telegram, and WhatsApp calls. They hear, speak, show an avatar, and share screens, and more.
